headline: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 models
body: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 on Monday, as the company readies for a potentially historic IPO. Anthropic says the models generate outputs 30% faster than their predecessors and cost 20% less than the 5.1 generation. TechCrunch says Anthropic is lowering the cost of Fable from $10 to $8 per million input tokens, and Anthropic said Mythos 5.2 is available to vetted organizations.
note: For banks, the split matters: Fable 5.2 is generally available, while Mythos 5.2 is available to vetted organizations.

evidence.text: Anthropic on Monday released two new artificial intelligence models, Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2, as the company readies for a potentially historic IPO that could take place as soon as next week.
Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 are Anthropic's most advanced offerings, and the company said they generate outputs 30% faster than their predecessors.
The models also cost 20% less than the 5.1 generation, and will be available for $8 per million input tokens and $40 per million output tokens, the company said.
Anthropic said Fable 5.2 is generally available on Monday, and Mythos 5.2 is available to vetted organizations through the company's Life Sciences and Cyber Verification Programs.
Notably, Anthropic is lowering the cost of Fable from $10 to $8 per million input tokens.
